pages.text: Feverfew has a sharp smell. It cools a cat with a fever and warms a cat with chills.
pages.title: Feverfew

pages.text: Poppy seeds calm a cat in shock and help them sleep. They can also ease chills. Shake the seeds out on an Herb Rock.
pages.title: Poppy Seeds

pages.text: A fever is often a sign of something else. If a Clanmate is feverish, check them with your Whiskers to see what else might be wrong.
